4165.note: Straight yellow-center two-lanes across flat scrubby grassland under pale washed sky, dark bonnet at bottom.

4166.name: Fruit-tree-row Czech lanes
4166.note: Narrow lanes past bare fruit-tree rows and dry brown fields, pylons, hills, brighter spring sky.

4167.name: Lush bush-verge field lanes
4167.note: Narrow lanes with lush grass verges, bushes and trees, fields behind.

4168.name: Cumulus Bolivian altiplano roads
4168.note: Yellow-center asphalt across dry shrub plateau and road cuts, saturated blue sky with scattered small cumulus.

4169.name: Open flat village approaches
4169.note: Wide roads approaching villages across flat open ground.

4170.name: Divided dual-carriageway highways
4170.note: Wide divided highways with medians and tall street lights, overcast, bonnet.

4171.name: Open edge-lined crop roads
4171.note: Wide edge-lined two-lanes past flat crop fields, trees, guardrail at times.

4172.name: Log-pile forestry roads
4172.note: Gravel and asphalt roads past stacked timber piles in spruce forest.

4173.name: Hilly curving jungle roads
4173.note: Curving lined roads on hilly slopes with dense jungle, cloud over mountains.

4174.name: Botswana paved-shoulder highways
4174.note: Straight highways with yellow edges and paved shoulders across flat pale sandy scrub, dark blue sky.

4175.name: Dusty-lot pole-lined roads
4175.note: Roads with poles past dusty lots and green crop fields, harsh sun.

4176.name: Open-lawn rural house lanes
4176.note: Open lanes past white and red houses with big lawns and fields, cumulus sky.

4177.name: Wide junction asphalt aprons
4177.note: Broad patched asphalt junctions and lot-like aprons with grass edges, scattered trees and low houses, blue sky.

4178.name: Edge-lined woodland roads
4178.note: White-lined asphalt through birch and deciduous woods and meadows, dappled shade, blue sky.

4179.name: Hedged Luxembourg new-builds
4179.note: Suburban streets with modern detached houses, tall clipped hedges, gardens and lawns, sunny sky.

4180.name: Overcast wide-shoulder highways
4180.note: Wide highways with gravel shoulders and median barriers through flat forest, heavy gray overcast.

4181.name: Traffic-filled city dual roads
4181.note: Dual carriageways with close traffic, grass medians, poles, clouds.

4182.name: Small-town fringe gum roads
4182.note: Roads at small-town edges with low houses, timber fences, poles and wires, gums, dry grassy verges.

4183.name: Fenced-garden suburban streets
4183.note: Denser suburban streets with metal fences, gardens and parked cars.

4184.name: Hazy flat-farmland lanes
4184.note: Narrow straight lanes across flat crop fields, canal edges, sparse trees, hazy sky.

4185.name: Tan-steppe Kazakh bonnet roads
4185.note: Lined roads across flat dry tan steppe with bare shrubs, faint distant hills, pale hazy sky, pale bonnet at bottom.

4186.name: Bare-woodland shaded lanes
4186.note: Asphalt lanes through open woodland of bare and budding trees, ivy, low sun with long shadows.

4187.name: Built-up paved back roads
4187.note: Paved back roads past white houses and wires, more built.

4188.name: Unlined hill-country farm tracks
4188.note: Narrow unlined gravel and asphalt tracks through dry fields and low hills.

4189.name: Leafy tree-lined rural roads
4189.note: Narrow asphalt roads lined with leafy trees and grass verges, few houses, lamp posts, white cloudy sky.

4190.name: Bright-sky forest two-lanes
4190.note: Straight lined two-lanes between dense green woods under brighter broken cloud, sunlit verges.

4191.name: Green-field flat farm roads
4191.note: Lined flat roads across open green fields and crops with only scattered olive rows, wide sky.

4192.name: Lush-scrub pale concrete lanes
4192.note: Narrow pale concrete or asphalt lanes through lush green scrub and tall grass, sunny.

4193.name: Dirt tracks by dry fields
4193.note: Red-dirt and concrete tracks past dry fields and ditches under bright cumulus skies.

4194.name: Dry-scrub bonnet dirt roads
4194.note: Pale orange dirt roads through dry thorny scrub and bare ground, bonnet visible, cumulus over blue sky.

4195.name: Overcast truck-traffic motorways
4195.note: Busy motorways with trucks, lush hills, overcast, dark car bonnet in view.

4196.name: Dry-leaf woodland laterite tracks
4196.note: Narrower orange laterite tracks through dense dry-season woodland with brown leaves and leafless trees, some blur.

4197.name: Village-edge willow lanes
4197.note: Lanes at village edges past houses, willows and gravel junctions, sunny.

4198.name: Hedge-lined garden lanes
4198.note: Narrow residential lanes with clipped hedges and gardens, low houses and fences.

4199.name: Mountain-backed farmland two-lanes
4199.note: Yellow-center two-lanes past green crop fields and trees with mountains on the horizon.

4200.name: Fenced back-lane laneways
4200.note: Narrow back lanes between metal and timber fences, garages, sheds.

4201.name: Dashed-yellow red-asphalt flats
4201.note: Very red asphalt with dashed yellow center and white edges across flat open land, grass shoulders, low bush.

4202.name: Terracotta-roof French lanes
4202.note: Lanes past houses with terracotta roofs, hedges and bare trees under gray cloud.

4203.name: Red-dirt Eswatini homestead tracks
4203.note: Red dirt tracks past scattered homesteads, maize patches and leafy scrub, poles with wires.

4204.name: Deep-blue-sky dry grass tracks
4204.note: Pale dirt tracks across dry grass and rolling hills under deep saturated blue sky, car hood sometimes visible.

4205.name: French leafy woodland lanes
4205.note: Narrow unmarked lanes between lush deciduous trees and hedges, grass verges, white cloudy sky, some blurred.

4206.name: Big-sky open-bush highways
4206.note: Lined highways through open low bush under dramatic cumulus skies.

4207.name: Wet gorge guardrail roads
4207.note: Wet roads with guardrails along rock cuts and steep wooded slopes, overcast.

4208.name: Tall-forest yellow-line roads
4208.note: Roads with yellow center lines through tall native forest, blue signs.

4209.name: Overcast fenced flatland roads
4209.note: Roads past fenced houses and walls on flat land under gray overcast sky.

4210.name: Mongolian snow-fog steppe roads
4210.note: Flat roads and tracks across snow-dusted steppe in fog, gray washed-out sky, smeared lens and roof rack in some.

4211.name: Dry-scrub stone-wall lanes
4211.note: Narrow worn lanes past dry grass, bushy shrubs and low stone walls, few buildings, bright blue sky.

4212.name: Bare-tree dry prairie streets
4212.note: Pale dirt and concrete streets past bare or sparse trees, dry lawns, scattered houses.

4213.name: North American freeway underpasses
4213.note: Wide freeways under broad concrete bridge decks, concrete lanes and grass medians.

4214.name: Hungarian tree-lined field roads
4214.note: Two-lanes with faint lines past poplars and tree rows, flat fields, poles, cumulus blue sky.

4215.name: Dense-scrub enclosed roads
4215.note: Asphalt with yellow center walled in by dense tall green scrub and trees, poles, cumulus sky.

4216.name: Pale concrete kiosk-lined lanes
4216.note: Pale concrete or bleached lanes, wooden kiosks and stilted houses close by, palms, many wires, blue sky.

4217.name: Wispy-sky shrubby gravel roads
4217.note: Gravel roads through dry grass and shrubs under wispy streaked cloud, mountains beyond.

4218.name: Autumn worn farm lanes
4218.note: Worn narrow lanes past autumn fields and yellowing trees, poles, low sun, cloudy sky.

4219.name: Sandy stick-fence streets
4219.note: Sandy streets lined with wooden stick fences and small wooden houses.

4220.name: Chaparral-slope hill roads
4220.note: Two-lanes through dry chaparral-covered hill slopes, bright sky.

4221.name: White-lined dry-hill two-lanes
4221.note: White-lined two-lanes through dry grassy hills with scattered trees and oaks, guardrails, blue sky.

4222.name: Dense-forest bonnet tracks
4222.note: Narrow dirt and asphalt tracks closely enclosed by dense dark rainforest, car bonnet at bottom.

4223.name: Low-sun winter farmland lanes
4223.note: Lanes past bare trees, ploughed and brown fields in low winter sun with long shadows.

4224.name: Car-blob red-dirt sunny roads
4224.note: Red-orange dirt roads with blurred car blob and shadow at bottom, sunny cumulus.

4225.name: Dirt-road Mexican desert edges
4225.note: Pale dirt roads across open dry desert past sparse block houses and fences, deep blue sky.

4226.name: Cornfield-lined hazy lanes
4226.note: Narrow lanes between corn and crop fields, hazy pale sky, smeared bottom in some.

4227.name: Flat dry altiplano tracks
4227.note: Pale gravel tracks and roads across flat dry tan grassland, low hills, clear sky.

4228.name: Tree-lined lowland yellow-lines
4228.note: Yellow-lined roads past denser green trees and bush, mixed cloud, car bonnet in some.

4229.name: Rural-edge Croatian fisheye lanes
4229.note: Narrower pale roads at village edges past hedges, trees and fields, fisheye look, bonnet at times, washed-out sky.

4230.name: Greenland fjord boat rides
4230.note: Camera on a boat with wake or bow ropes on dark fjord water, snow-streaked rocky mountains, gray sky.

4231.name: Cliff-ringed Lesotho valley roads
4231.note: Narrow paved or dirt roads in green valleys under sandstone cliffs and rocky hills, cumulus sky, livestock.

4232.name: Zebra-crossed Gulf avenues
4232.note: Wide asphalt avenues with zebra crossings, signal poles, tall street lights, painted curbs and pale low buildings in hard sun.

4233.name: White-edge Patagonian scrub roads
4233.note: Two-lane asphalt with double yellow center and white edge lines, patches of scrub or forest, gray cloudy sky.

4234.name: Red-soil savanna lined highways
4234.note: Sealed roads with white edge and center lines, red soil verges, open savanna with scattered gum trees, cumulus sky.

4235.name: Guardrailed Tunisian town roads
4235.note: Wide urban-edge roads with guardrails and long walls, flat-roof concrete buildings, trucks, hazy sun.

4236.name: Outback red-verge highways
4236.note: Sealed two-lane with white edge lines, wide red-orange soil verges, low mallee scrub and saltbush, bright cumulus sky.

4237.name: Yellow-edge Chilean steppe roads
4237.note: Concrete or asphalt roads with yellow edge and center lines across flat treeless steppe under overcast or fog.

4238.name: Flat-plain Kenyan dirt tracks
4238.note: Straight pinkish-tan dirt roads across dead-flat grass or golden plains, scattered acacia, hazy blue sky.

4239.name: Arctic tundra trekker trails
4239.note: Trekker views off-road on bare grassy or rocky tundra slopes and ridges, mountains beyond, cloudy sky.

4240.name: Flat Tunisian farmland roads
4240.note: Pale worn asphalt with dashed lines through flat plowed or dry fields, scattered trees and poles, hazy sky.

4241.name: Mongolian divided highways
4241.note: Wide multi-lane roads with white lines, metal guardrails, median barriers, tall lamps and open grassy steppe.

4242.name: Canyon river raft views
4242.note: Camera on a raft or at water level in rivers between red rock canyon walls, rafters or swimmers in view.

4243.name: Tall-grass Namibian bush tar
4243.note: White bonnet on narrow tar roads with tall dry grass and bush verges, bright blue sky.

4244.name: Flat Kazakh semi-desert roads
4244.note: Straight roads and dirt tracks across dead-flat tan semi-desert with salt patches, white bonnet often in view.

4245.name: Tarp-rack Mongolian steppe tracks
4245.note: Tarp-covered load on the car roof in view on dirt tracks across flat grassy or bare steppe, big blue sky.

4246.name: Dry-grass Namibian acacia tracks
4246.note: White car bonnet in view on pale sand or gravel roads through tall dry grass with lone acacias, hazy pale sky.

4247.name: Cumulus-sky Botswana bush roads
4247.note: Narrow tar with faded lines through flat dry grass and acacia bush under bright puffy cumulus.

4248.name: Flat bare Namibian desert tar
4248.note: Wide sealed roads with white or yellow edge lines across flat bare tan desert, clear sky.

4249.name: Bolivian lowland concrete highways
4249.note: Pale concrete slab highways with faint lines through flat green scrub and bush, cumulus sky.

4250.name: Bermuda island lanes
4250.note: Narrow curving lanes with white-roofed houses, stone walls, palms and dense green shrubs.

4251.name: White-shoulder Botswana highways
4251.note: Sealed roads with broad white sand or gravel shoulders, low scrub and scattered acacias, sunny sky.

4252.name: Built-up Lebanese motorways
4252.note: Multi-lane highways with guardrails and traffic, concrete buildings and shops along the edges, scrubby hills, hazy sun.

4253.name: Indian tea-garden lanes
4253.note: Narrow lanes and tracks through low clipped tea bushes with tall scattered shade trees, flat ground.

4254.name: Rock-cut Bolivian valley roads
4254.note: Paved roads with yellow center lines through rock cuts in dry brown mountains, cumulus sky.

4255.name: Brown-steppe Mongolian rack tracks
4255.note: Dark car roof with rack rails in view on multi-rut dirt tracks across bare brown steppe ringed by low hills.

4256.name: Brazilian river water-level views
4256.note: Camera at water level on calm forest-lined rivers with reflections; some swimmers and gorge pools.

4257.name: Madagascar roof-rack forest tracks
4257.note: Metal roof rack in view on sandy dirt tracks through dry deciduous scrub forest; some trekker-style views.

4258.name: Canary pine-forest roads
4258.note: Winding narrow roads through tall open pines, pale rocky cut banks with dry needle litter, clear sky.

4259.name: Yellow-edged Botswana highways
4259.note: Dark tar with yellow edge lines and dashed white center, dry grass and sandy verges, lone acacias, sunny.

4260.name: Overcast Kazakh steppe highways
4260.note: White bonnet on straight two-lane asphalt across flat tan steppe under a full overcast gray sky.

4261.name: Orange-dune Omani sand roads
4261.note: Graded sand roads with raised berms through orange sand plains with dunes on the horizon, pale clear sky.

4262.name: Turkish open-plain motorways
4262.note: Divided multi-lane motorways with guardrails and dashed lines across open flat plains, bright cumulus sky.

4263.name: Bangladesh river boat views
4263.note: Camera on a boat over wide brown water under a hazy gray sky, with low tree-lined banks or a stone jetty.

4264.name: Leafy-tree Botswana sand tracks
4264.note: White-sand tracks through dry grass under leafy green broadleaf trees, bright sun.

4265.name: Hazy faded-line Botswana roads
4265.note: Narrow worn tar with faded lines through dry grass and bush, hazy or low-sun sky.

4266.name: Patagonian gravel steppe roads
4266.note: Wide straight gravel roads across dead-flat dry scrub steppe under heavy cumulus and gray cloud.

4267.name: Bare-desert Namibian gravel roads
4267.note: White bonnet on flat pale gravel roads through sparse low shrubs and bare sand, with pylons in places.

4268.name: Open dry-field Israeli highways
4268.note: Divided highways with guardrails through open dry fields and lone trees, hazy sky with cumulus.

4269.name: Silver roof-rack Kenyan highways
4269.note: Silver car roof with black rack bars in view on paved roads through red soil and green scrub, cumulus sky.

4270.name: Argentine scrub highways
4270.note: Straight two-lane asphalt with white edge lines across flat low scrub, gray or partly cloudy sky.

4271.name: Pale yellow-line Chaco roads
4271.note: Pale smooth road with a single yellow center line, wide green grass verges, low bush and a broken-cloud sky.

4272.name: Mongolian roof-rack steppe roads
4272.note: Dark car roof with rack in view on a paved road through bare brown steppe under a cumulus sky.
